what: A free third-party WordPress plugin that automatically converts Payhip product page links into "Buy" overlay boxes.
verbatim_snippet: "Integrates Payhip into WordPress. When a Payhip product page link is clicked, it will open a Payhip 'Buy' box. To use, just install and activate the plugin. There are no settings, it will automatically work on all links to Payhip product pages, both existing and new ones."
